name: zapier-pp-mcp
description: Read-only CLI for your Zapier account: list zaps, check run history, diagnose failures.

zapier_base_url.title: ZAPIER_BASE_URL
zapier_base_url.description: Optional. Sets ZAPIER_BASE_URL for the Zapier MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

zapier_session_cookie.title: ZAPIER_SESSION_COOKIE
zapier_session_cookie.description: Sets ZAPIER_SESSION_COOKIE for the Zapier MCP server.

zapier_user_agent.title: ZAPIER_USER_AGENT
zapier_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets ZAPIER_USER_AGENT for the Zapier MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
